_note: Copy this file to docs/submission/sme.local.json, which .gitignore keeps untracked (docs/submission/*.local.json), and never commit it. Fill it with CONFIRMED facts only: what the partner has confirmed, ideally in writing. scripts/submission/build_nus_docs.py replaces each {{KEY}} in nus-iss-business.md and nus-iss-technical.md with its value when it builds the PDFs; an empty value prints as a highlighted [TEAM TO FILL] and is counted. The problem statement (nus-iss-problem-statement.md) is not built: replace its tokens by hand. Keys: SME_NAME = the partner's registered English name; SME_NAME_ZH = its registered Chinese name, if it has one; SME_UEN = the UEN of the entity that actually employs our team member; SME_CRS = its BCA workhead and grade, written to follow 'registered with BCA under', e.g. 'workhead CR16 (Curtain Walls), grade <grade>'; SME_REP_ROLE = our team member's role at the partner, written to follow 'works at the partner as', e.g. '<role> since <month year>'; SME_FEEDBACK = what the partner told us, verbatim or faithfully summarised, only in words it agreed to, as a full paragraph.
